Jo Malone London

Jo Malone London Basil & Neroli Cologne - 100ml

An aromatic cologne with notes of fresh basil and neroli.

Get 625 LF Beauty Plus+ Points

hours
minutes

Available globally, quintessentially British brand Jo Malone has built an impressive reputation for luxury bath and body products. Boasting an extensive fragrance portfolio and unafraid to test new waters when it comes to blending scents, the brand continues to garner a devoted following inspired by their creativity.

Jo Malone London Basil and Neroli Cologne is the embodiment of clean and fresh with an unexpected undercurrent of complexity. Emerging with a tentative herbaceous air, Basil’s peppery freshness opens a spicy green landscape that’s more sophisticated than simple cut-grass. Neroli’s delicate white petals bloom in honey-sweet clusters, brightening the fragrance like sunlight on an overcast day. Finished off with fresh laundry drying on the line, White Musk’s powdery clean notes envelop the cologne and bring together a picturesque afternoon.

Housed in a rectangular bottle that’s reminiscent of Jo Malone’s townhouse in London, it’s truly the scent of British summertime.

Mist one or two sprays around your neck and on your pulse points (areas where the body is warmer, such as the wrists, ankles, inside the elbows and behind the knees) from a minimum distance of 6 inches, then allow to dry without rubbing.

Top Note: Basil.
Heart Note: Neroli.
Base Note: White Musk.

Alcohol Denat., Water\Aqua\Eau, Fragrance (Parfum), Linalool, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Geraniol, Limonene, Citral, Eugenol, Citronellol, Bht, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate.

For the latest information, it is recommended to review the ingredient list printed on the packaging of the product prior to usage or consumption.
